quotes.text: In D210599, a reviewer requested replacing substr in the carried-over calendar search parser. The landed implementation uses String.slice for the quoted token and remaining query spans. This is an accepted local syntax preference beyond formatter output; it does not by itself prove a repository-wide ban on substring. Current aboutImport.js continues to use slice.
